idea.title: Elevador topete no teto
idea.text: elevador de prédio comercial: o topete encosta no teto e ele inclina a cabeça 30 graus sem mudar a cara

script.title: Elevador nao fecha
script.premise: Num elevador comercial, as portas tentam fechar, batem na ponta do topete que passa da linha da porta e reabrem; ele segue sério, parado, olhando a lente.
script.gag_without_sound: a porta do elevador bate no topete e reabre sozinha, e ele nem pisca

location.place: elevador de prédio comercial antigo no centro

camera.height: altura do peito, do hall, a 3 m, de frente para a porta

beats.action: dentro do elevador, na frente, faz o passo brega com o dedo pra cima e a mão na barriga
beats.extras: 4 pessoas atrás dele olham o celular ou o painel de andares

beats.action: as duas folhas da porta deslizam, batem na ponta do topete que passa da linha da porta e reabrem; ele fica parado, sério

script.end_state: portas abertas de novo, ele parado no centro com o dedo pra cima, sério

props.name: porta de elevador de inox em duas folhas
props.orientation: folhas deslizam da esquerda e da direita do quadro para o centro

pico do passo brega, quadril para a esquerda do quadro

script.start_frame: Gersinho no centro de um elevador comercial lotado, porta aberta, de frente para a câmera no hall, pose de assinatura
script.end_frame: mesmo quadro, portas abertas de novo, ele parado, sério
script.caption: Elevador de serviço não está preparado para o Gerson.
script.originality_note: primeira piada com mecanismo (sensor de porta); repete-se em loop
script.risks: as portas cortarem o topete ao meio ou o topete entortar; o modelo inventar corte. Conferir o painel 3 e G3.

en.gag_sentence: In an office elevator he does his signature brega step at the front until the closing steel doors bump the tip of his rigid pompadour and slide open again.
en.location: an old office-building elevator in downtown São Paulo seen from the lobby through its open doors, brushed steel walls, a small floor-number display above the door, fluorescent morning light
en.location_map: Center: the open elevator cabin, 1.5 m wide, with him at the front just behind the door line. Frame-left and frame-right: the two brushed-steel door leaves retracted into the door frame. Above: the floor-number display. Foreground: the lobby floor tiles.
en.position: centered at the front of the cabin, chest square to the lens, his face 10 cm behind the door line; the front of the pompadour leans forward and its tip crosses the door line by 10 cm
en.signature_pose: left hand flat on his belly, right index finger raised beside his head, feet together
en.extras_tasks: two office workers behind him read their phones, one looks up at the floor display, one holds a coffee cup and looks at the wall
en.props: exactly one elevator door made of two brushed-steel leaves, fully open, retracted at frame-left and frame-right
en.hands: He has exactly two hands: left hand flat on his belly, right index finger raised.

stages.text: He holds the signature pose from the start frame; breathing lifts the chest, one slow blink.
stages.end_state: same pose, eyes into the lens.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

stages.text: Real-time, at 95 BPM: he shifts his weight onto his left foot, heel first; his hips sway once to frame-left and once to frame-right on the beat; his raised right index finger moves up and down twice on the beat.
stages.end_state: feet together, finger raised, chest square to the lens.
stages.facing: chest within 30° of the lens while the hips sway, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

stages.text: The two steel door leaves slide in from frame-left and frame-right toward the center at walking pace; they touch the tip of the pompadour that sticks out past the door line, stop, and slide back open to the frame edges; the pompadour keeps its exact outline.
stages.end_state: doors fully open again, pompadour unchanged.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

stages.text: Everything settles and holds; he stares into the lens, finger raised. The final frame matches the end frame.
stages.end_state: doors fully open at the frame edges, he stands still, finger raised, deadpan.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

en.end_change: the two steel door leaves are fully open again at the frame edges; he stands still at the front of the cabin, finger raised, deadpan; the passengers keep their tasks
en.end_props: both door leaves retracted at frame-left and frame-right, fully open
en.props_lock: Exactly one elevator door with two brushed-steel leaves: open at the start, touching the pompadour tip at 7.5 s, open again at the end.
en.lighting: Fluorescent overhead light inside the cabin, cool 4000K, even and flat, soft reflections on the brushed steel.
panels: centered at the front of the open elevator cabin, signature pose, chest square to the lens, pompadour tip 10 cm past the door line
hips swayed to frame-left at the peak of the brega step, finger raised, passengers on their phones
the two steel door leaves meeting the tip of the pompadour at the door line, stopped
doors fully open again, he stands still and deadpan, finger raised
